definitions.explanation: Excessive praise or compliments given to gain favor, often insincere. A literary term with negative connotations.

examples.japanese: {阿諛|あゆ}⟦{追従|ついしょう}→追従：07883_tsuishou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嫌|きら}い→嫌い：02871_kirai⟧だ。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}→権力者：17021_kenryokusha⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{阿諛|あゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: His writing has a whiff of flattery toward those in power.

examples.japanese: {阿諛|あゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弄|ろう}する⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}できない→信用する：25371_shinyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Those who resort to flattery cannot be trusted.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {阿諛|あゆ}⟦{追従|ついしょう}→追従：07883_tsuishou⟧: flattery and sycophancy; the four-character compound in which the word is most often met
- {阿諛|あゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弄|ろう}する: to resort to flattery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{媚|こ}びる→媚びる：09028_kobiru⟧: to fawn, to curry favor; the everyday verb.
- ⟦お{世辞|せじ}→お世辞：07023_oseji⟧: a compliment, flattery; everyday and not necessarily negative.
{阿諛|あゆ} is a written, literary word and is always critical.
